room_rent.display: Single Private Room (or 1% of SI/day depending on plan schedule)
room_rent.note: Policy Schedule specifies either 'Single Private Room' or 'up to 1% of SI per day'. If room chosen exceeds eligible category, Associate Medical Expenses are pro-rated. Optional Benefit 5 (Room Rent Modification) removes all room/ICU limits for SI ≥5L.

icu.display: Up to 2% of SI/day (or no sub-limit per schedule)
icu.note: Policy Schedule specifies either '2% of SI per day' or 'no sub-limit' for ICU charges. No Claims Bonus does not form part of SI for ICU calculation. Optional Benefit 5 removes ICU cap.

copayment.display: None (20% mandatory if age 61+ at first policy issuance)
copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay per claim for insured persons aged 61+ at first policy issuance. Optional Co-Payment benefit (Optional Benefit 2) allows voluntary co-pay for premium discount. Global Coverage (Benefit 12) carries additional 10% co-pay.

sub_limits.display: Few sub-limits; room/ICU caps per schedule; day-care list-based
sub_limits.note: Room rent and ICU charges are sub-limited per policy schedule. Day care treatment limited to listed procedures (Annexure I). Chemotherapy/radiotherapy and dialysis covered up to SI. No disease-wise monetary sub-limits beyond room/ICU noted.

deductible.note: Deductible is an optional benefit (Optional Benefit 1) applied on aggregate basis per policy year; reduces premium. Not inbuilt.

initial_waiting.note: No illness claims within 90 days of first policy commencement; accident claims exempt. Waived if continuous coverage >12 months.

ped_waiting.note: Standard PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional Benefit 8 (Reduction of PED Wait Period) reduces it to 24 months; available only at inception.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applicable only for Operation Mediclaim plan (Excl02). Listed conditions include arthritis, cataract, hernia, ENT surgeries, BPH, D&C, varicose veins, kidney/gall stones, fibroids, hysterectomy, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a permanent exclusion (Code Excl18) under this policy. Ectopic pregnancy is also excluded except as noted.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% after 1st claim-free year, 25% after 2nd, 25% after 3rd; max 100% of SI. Reduced at same rate if claim occurs. Forfeited if policy lapses.

restoration.note: Optional Benefit 3 (Unlimited Automatic Recharge): unlimited reinstatements of SI during policy year, but only for claims unrelated to any illness/injury for which a claim has already been admitted that year. Available only as optional add-on for SI >1L and ≤50L.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission, for same condition as inpatient claim.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge, for same condition as inpatient claim.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered only for procedures listed in Annexure I to policy terms. List varies by plan opted.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered where patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room available in hospital.

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH treatment (Ayurveda, Siddha, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Homeopathy) covered up to SI at registered AYUSH hospitals, linked to accepted inpatient claim under Benefit 1.

organ_donor.display: Covered up to policy schedule limit
organ_donor.note: Organ donor medical expenses covered up to limit in policy schedule, linked to accepted inpatient claim. Pre/post-hospitalisation expenses for donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to amount specified in policy schedule. Air ambulance is a separate optional benefit (Optional Benefit 7).

modern_treatments.note: Covered: Uterine Artery Embolization, HIFU, Balloon Sinuplasty, Deep Brain Stimulation, Oral Chemotherapy, Immunotherapy (monoclonal antibody injections), Intravitreal injections, Robotic surgeries, Stereotactic radiosurgeries, Bronchial Thermoplasty, Vaporisation of prostate (green/holmium laser), IONM, Stem cell therapy for haematological conditions.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure II are excluded. No consumables cover rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Benefit 12 (Global Coverage): inpatient and day care hospitalisation outside India covered up to SI for SI ≥100L. Mandatory 10% co-pay. Coverage for 45 continuous days per trip, 90 days cumulative per year. Room Rent Modification (OB5) not applicable for global claims.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Applies to original SI; fresh 5-year period on enhanced SI.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines, with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, STDs (except HIV-related as defined), external congenital anomalies, mental retardation, sleep disorder instruments, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, cosmetic surgery, hazardous sports (professional), OPD-only procedures
optional_riders: Deductible option, Co-payment option, Unlimited Automatic Recharge, International Second Opinion, Room Rent Modification (no room cap), Additional SI for Accidental Hospitalisation, Air Ambulance Cover, PED wait period reduction (36→24 months)
